Use light pressure and avoid the front of the neck.

Keep pressure superficial and comfortable.

name: Teres Major Floor Ball Sweep
instructions: Lie on your side with the ball beneath the posterior shoulder.
Reach the arm overhead.
Shift the torso slowly through the muscle.

name: Teres Major Massage Cane Release
instructions: Use the massage cane over accessible teres-major tissue.
Apply comfortable pressure.
Avoid pressing directly into the axilla.

name: Subscapularis Soft Ball Lateral Release
instructions: Place a very soft ball on accessible lateral upper-torso tissue near the posterior axilla.
Apply minimal pressure.
Avoid the axilla and shoulder joint.

name: Subscapularis Wall Ball Lateral Release
instructions: Position a soft ball against accessible tissue at the lateral upper torso.
Lean gently toward the wall.
Use very light pressure and stay away from the axilla.

name: Subscapularis Tennis Ball Lateral Release
instructions: Use the tennis ball against accessible tissue near the lateral scapular border.
Apply minimal pressure.
Avoid the axilla and shoulder joint.

name: Subscapularis Soft Ball Sweep
instructions: Place the soft ball on accessible lateral torso tissue.
Shift the body slightly to sweep across the region.
Maintain minimal pressure.

name: Subscapularis Wall Release With Arm Position
instructions: Place the ball at accessible lateral torso tissue near the scapula.
Slowly change the arm position.
Use minimal pressure throughout.

name: Subscapularis Low-Intensity Vibrating Release
instructions: Place a soft vibrating ball over accessible lateral torso tissue.
Use the lowest comfortable intensity.
Avoid the axilla and shoulder joint.

name: Subscapularis Double Soft Ball Release
instructions: Use the double ball on accessible lateral scapular-border tissue.
Lean gently into the wall.
Keep pressure very light.

name: Subscapularis Lateral Fingertip Release
instructions: Use the fingertips around accessible tissue near the lateral scapular border.
Apply superficial pressure only.
Avoid deep pressure into the armpit.

name: Subscapularis Superficial Circular Release
instructions: Use fingertips over accessible superficial tissue near the lateral scapular border.
Make very small circles.
Do not attempt deep pressure into the scapular fossa.

name: Subscapularis Superficial Sweep
instructions: Gently sweep the fingertips across accessible lateral shoulder-blade tissue.
Use superficial pressure.
Avoid the axilla.

name: Subscapularis Supported Soft Ball Release
instructions: Support the arm and position a soft ball against accessible lateral torso tissue.
Allow only gentle contact.
Avoid deep pressure around the armpit.

name: Subscapularis Accessible Lateral Stick Release
instructions: Use only the soft end of a massage stick on accessible lateral torso tissue.
Apply very light pressure.
Avoid the axilla and shoulder joint.

name: Subscapularis Wall Sweep Release
instructions: Place the soft ball at the lateral border of the scapular region.
Slowly move the torso across the area.
Keep pressure very gentle.

name: Seated SCM Stretch With Rotation
instructions: Sit upright and gently retract the shoulders.
Turn the head away from the side being stretched and slightly tilt the head toward the opposite side.
Hold a gentle stretch along the front and side of the neck.

name: Supine SCM Rotation and Tilt Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the head supported.
Rotate the head away from the target side and gently tilt it away from the target shoulder.
Maintain a mild, pain-free stretch.

name: Seated SCM Extension-Rotation Stretch
instructions: Sit tall with the spine neutral.
Rotate the head away from the target side and gently extend the neck.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.

name: Wall-Assisted SCM Stretch
instructions: Stand with the shoulder on the target side lightly supported against a wall.
Turn the head away from the target side and gently angle the chin upward.
Keep the shoulder relaxed.

name: Towel-Assisted SCM Stretch
instructions: Place a towel around the upper back or shoulders for light postural support.
Rotate the head away from the target side and gently tilt it away.
Use the towel only for positioning, not to force the neck.

name: Seated Chin-Up SCM Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and relax the shoulders.
Turn the head away from the target side and gently lift the chin.
Hold the stretch without forcing cervical extension.

name: Side-Lying SCM Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with the target side uppermost.
Allow the head to move gently away from the target shoulder while rotating away.
Use a small range and keep the neck relaxed.

name: Opposite-Hand SCM Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and lightly anchor the target-side shoulder downward.
Rotate and gently tilt the head away from the target side.
Use the opposite hand only as light positional guidance.

name: Standing SCM Postural Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with the target-side shoulder relaxed.
Gently rotate the head away and slightly extend the neck.
Keep the rib cage stacked over the pelvis.

name: SCM Diagonal-Gaze Stretch
instructions: Sit comfortably with the shoulders down.
Turn the head away from the target side and direct the gaze slightly upward and outward.
Maintain a gentle stretch without creating neck discomfort.

name: Supported Supine SCM Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with a thin pillow supporting the head.
Rotate the head away from the target side and gently tilt it away.
Let the pillow support the head rather than actively pushing into the stretch.

name: SCM Stretch With Scapular Anchor
instructions: Sit tall and gently draw the target shoulder down and back.
Rotate the head away and slightly extend the neck.
Maintain a mild stretch along the SCM.

name: Seated Upper Trapezius Side-Bend Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and keep the target shoulder relaxed.
Tilt the head away from the target side.
Maintain a gentle stretch between the neck and shoulder.

name: Upper Trapezius Hand-Anchored Stretch
instructions: Place the hand of the target side under the thigh to anchor the shoulder.
Tilt the head away from that side.
Add a slight forward turn if comfortable.

name: Upper Trapezius Flexion-Rotation Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and lower the chin slightly toward the chest.
Turn the head slightly away from the target side.
Keep the target shoulder down.

name: Standing Upper Trapezius Wall Stretch
instructions: Stand with the target-side shoulder lightly against a wall.
Tilt the head away from the target shoulder.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and avoid shrugging.

name: Supine Upper Trapezius Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the head supported.
Gently draw the chin toward the chest and tilt the head away from the target side.
Keep the shoulder heavy and relaxed.

name: Upper Trapezius Towel-Anchored Stretch
instructions: Place a towel under the target hand or around the upper arm for light anchoring.
Tilt the head away from the target side.
Keep the stretch mild and controlled.

name: Upper Trapezius Chin-Tuck Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and gently tuck the chin.
Tilt the head away from the target side.
Keep both shoulders relaxed.

name: Standing Lateral Upper Trapezius Stretch
instructions: Stand with the arms resting by your sides.
Reach the target-side hand toward the floor while tilting the head away.
Avoid lifting the shoulder toward the ear.

name: Upper Trapezius Rotation Stretch
instructions: Sit upright with the target shoulder relaxed.
Tilt the head away and rotate slightly toward the target side.
Hold the position without forcing the neck.

name: Upper Trapezius Corner Stretch
instructions: Stand near a wall corner with the target shoulder relaxed.
Tilt the head away from the target side while keeping the torso upright.
Maintain gentle tension without shrugging.

name: Supported Head Upper Trapezius Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the head comfortably supported.
Gently position the head away from the target shoulder.
Let the support carry the weight of the head.

name: Upper Trapezius Forward-Tilt Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and anchor the target arm gently.
Lower the chin slightly and tilt the head away.
Keep the shoulder blade heavy.

name: Seated Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and place the hand of the target side under the thigh.
Turn the head away and look downward toward the opposite armpit.
Hold a gentle stretch along the back and side of the neck.

name: Standing Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with the target arm relaxed.
Turn the head away from the target side and gently look toward the opposite pocket.
Keep the shoulder depressed.

name: Supine Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target shoulder relaxed.
Rotate the head away and gently flex the neck toward the opposite armpit.
Keep the head supported if needed.

name: Levator Scapulae Towel-Anchored Stretch
instructions: Use a towel to gently anchor the target arm downward.
Turn the head away and look diagonally downward.
Keep the stretch mild.

name: Levator Scapulae Wall-Anchored Stretch
instructions: Stand beside a wall and lightly anchor the target shoulder or arm.
Turn the head away and look down toward the opposite side.
Avoid shrugging the shoulder.

name: Seated Levator Scapulae Flexion Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and anchor the target arm.
Bring the chin gently toward the opposite chest.
Keep the neck relaxed.

name: Chin-to-Pocket Levator Stretch
instructions: Sit tall with the target shoulder down.
Turn the head away and lower the chin diagonally toward the opposite pocket.
Hold without pulling on the head.

name: Supported Head Levator Stretch
instructions: Lie comfortably with the head supported.
Turn the head away from the target side and gently angle the chin downward.
Relax the shoulder completely.

name: Prone Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with the arms relaxed.
Turn the head away from the target side and gently look toward the floor.
Keep the target shoulder away from the ear.

name: Quadruped Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Begin on hands and knees with the spine neutral.
Shift the head gently toward the opposite armpit while keeping the target shoulder stable.
Maintain controlled breathing.

name: Levator Scapulae Corner Stretch
instructions: Stand near a corner and lightly anchor the target arm.
Rotate the head away and look downward.
Keep the shoulder blade stable.

name: Suboccipital Gentle Chin-Nod Stretch
instructions: Sit or lie comfortably with the head supported.
Perform a gentle chin nod without flexing the entire neck.
Hold the back of the skull in a relaxed position.

name: Supported Suboccipital Flexion Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the head lightly supported.
Gently nod the chin toward the throat.
Avoid lifting the head from the support.

name: Seated Suboccipital Chin Tuck Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and look straight ahead.
Draw the chin backward and slightly downward as if making a double chin.
Hold without rounding the upper back.

name: Wall-Supported Suboccipital Stretch
instructions: Stand with the back of the head lightly touching a wall.
Gently draw the chin inward without losing contact with the wall.
Relax the jaw and shoulders.

name: Suboccipital Towel-Assisted Stretch
instructions: Place a towel around the back of the head.
Gently nod the chin while allowing the towel to support the skull.
Do not pull the head forcefully forward.

name: Supine Deep Neck Flexion Position
instructions: Lie flat with the head supported naturally.
Perform a small chin nod while keeping the back of the head grounded.
Maintain relaxed breathing.

name: Seated Supported Suboccipital Nod
instructions: Sit against a chair with the upper back supported.
Gently nod the chin downward without collapsing the chest.
Keep the shoulders relaxed.

name: Suboccipital Supported Ball Stretch
instructions: Place a soft ball beneath the upper neck or base-of-skull region.
Allow the head to rest gently while performing a tiny chin nod.
Use very light pressure.

name: Wall Chin-Tuck Suboccipital Stretch
instructions: Stand with the head lightly supported against the wall.
Gently glide the chin backward and slightly downward.
Maintain a neutral trunk.

name: Supine Towel-Supported Suboccipital Stretch
instructions: Roll a towel into a thin support under the neck.
Rest the head comfortably and gently nod the chin.
Do not allow the towel to force excessive neck extension.

name: Seated Cervical Retraction Stretch
instructions: Sit tall with the eyes level.
Retract the head straight backward without looking up or down.
Hold the end position gently.

name: Seated Scalene Lateral Flexion Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and depress the target shoulder gently.
Tilt the head away from the target side.
Keep the face forward and the jaw relaxed.

name: Seated Scalene Rotation-Tilt Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and keep the target shoulder down.
Rotate the head slightly away and tilt it away from the target side.
Maintain a gentle lateral-neck stretch.

name: Seated Anterior Scalene Extension Stretch
instructions: Sit tall with the target shoulder gently depressed.
Turn the face slightly away and lift the chin a small amount.
Avoid excessive cervical extension.

name: Wall-Anchored Scalene Stretch
instructions: Stand beside a wall and use the target arm to maintain a relaxed shoulder position.
Tilt the head away and slightly rotate the face upward.
Keep the stretch comfortable.

name: Scalene Towel-Anchored Stretch
instructions: Use a towel to gently anchor the target shoulder downward.
Tilt the head away from the anchored side.
Keep the pressure minimal.

name: Supine Scalene Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target shoulder relaxed.
Gently position the head away from the target side.
Keep the neck supported and avoid forcing extension.

name: Scalene Chin-Up Tilt Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and gently lower the target shoulder.
Tilt the head away and lift the chin slightly.
Maintain only a mild stretch.

name: Standing Scalene Postural Stretch
instructions: Stand with the ribs stacked over the pelvis.
Depress the target shoulder gently and tilt the head away.
Keep the head from translating forward.

name: Scalene Corner Stretch
instructions: Stand beside a wall corner and lightly anchor the target shoulder.
Tilt the head away from the anchor.
Keep the neck relaxed.

name: Supported Head Scalene Stretch
instructions: Lie comfortably with the head supported.
Allow the head to rest slightly away from the target shoulder.
Maintain relaxed breathing.

name: Scalene Opposite-Gaze Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and relax the target shoulder.
Tilt the head away and rotate the gaze gently upward and outward.
Do not force the movement.

name: Standing Gastrocnemius Wall Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the target leg behind you.
Keep the rear knee straight and heel grounded.
Lean forward until a stretch is felt in the upper calf.

name: Step Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Stand on a step with the target heel slightly off the edge.
Keep the knee straight.
Lower the heel slowly until a comfortable calf stretch is felt.

name: Slant Board Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Place the target foot on a slant board with the heel grounded.
Keep the knee straight.
Lean forward gently from the hips.

name: Supine Band-Assisted Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target leg extended.
Loop a band around the forefoot.
Gently pull the toes toward you while keeping the knee straight.

name: Supine Towel Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target leg straight.
Wrap the towel around the forefoot.
Pull gently into dorsiflexion while keeping the knee extended.

name: Rear-Leg Straight Gastrocnemius Lunge Stretch
instructions: Take a staggered stance with the target leg behind.
Keep the rear knee straight and heel down.
Shift the body forward until the calf stretches.

name: Downward-Facing Dog Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Begin in a downward-facing dog position.
Press the target heel toward the floor while keeping the knee extended.
Maintain a long spine and relaxed shoulders.

name: Single-Leg Heel Drop Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Stand with the forefoot of the target leg on a step.
Keep the knee straight and hold a stable support.
Lower the heel slowly into a gentle stretch.

name: Wall Lean Heel-Down Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Place the target foot behind you with the heel planted.
Keep the rear knee straight.
Lean your body toward the wall.

name: Split-Stance Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Take a long split stance.
Straighten the target rear knee and keep the heel grounded.
Move the pelvis forward slowly.

name: Seated Extended-Leg Gastrocnemius Stretch
instructions: Sit with the target leg extended.
Use a strap around the forefoot to gently pull the ankle into dorsiflexion.
Keep the knee straight.

name: Elevated-Toe Gastrocnemius Wall Stretch
instructions: Place the forefoot of the target leg on a small platform with the heel grounded.
Keep the knee straight.
Lean forward with light wall support.

name: Bent-Knee Soleus Wall Stretch
instructions: Place the target leg behind you and bend both knees slightly.
Keep the rear heel grounded.
Shift the knee forward until the lower calf stretches.

name: Wall Knee-Drive Soleus Stretch
instructions: Place the target foot flat with the knee slightly bent.
Drive the knee forward over the toes without lifting the heel.
Hold the end position comfortably.

name: Bent-Knee Slant Board Soleus Stretch
instructions: Stand on the slant board with both knees slightly bent.
Keep the heels grounded.
Shift the knees forward gently.

name: Seated Bent-Knee Soleus Stretch
instructions: Sit with the target knee bent and foot flat.
Move the knee forward over the toes while keeping the heel down.
Hold a comfortable stretch in the lower calf.

name: Seated Bent-Knee Soleus Towel Stretch
instructions: Sit with the target knee bent.
Loop a towel around the forefoot and gently assist dorsiflexion.
Keep the heel on the floor.

name: Seated Bent-Knee Soleus Band Stretch
instructions: Sit with the target knee comfortably bent.
Loop a band around the forefoot and gently draw the ankle upward.
Keep the heel grounded.

name: Bent-Knee Step Soleus Stretch
instructions: Place the forefoot on a step with the knee slightly bent.
Lower the heel slowly while maintaining the bent-knee position.
Hold a mild stretch.

name: Knee-Forward Ankle Mobility Soleus Stretch
instructions: Place the target foot flat on the floor.
Bend the knee forward over the second or third toe while keeping the heel down.
Hold the end position gently.

name: Bent-Knee Split-Stance Soleus Stretch
instructions: Take a staggered stance with the target leg behind.
Bend both knees and keep the rear heel grounded.
Shift the body forward slowly.

name: Deep Knee-Bend Soleus Wall Stretch
instructions: Stand close to a wall with the target foot flat.
Bend the target knee forward while keeping the heel planted.
Use the wall for balance.

name: Supported Squat Soleus Stretch
instructions: Hold a stable support and lower into a comfortable squat.
Keep the heels down and knees traveling forward.
Maintain an upright, controlled position.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel with the target leg behind and the other foot forward.
Posteriorly tilt the pelvis and gently shift the hips forward.
Keep the torso upright.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch With Overhead Reach
instructions: Assume a half-kneeling position with the target leg behind.
Tuck the pelvis and shift forward gently.
Reach the same-side arm overhead without arching the lower back.

name: Couch Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Place the target shin against a couch or padded surface behind you.
Position the other foot forward and gently extend the hip.
Keep the ribs down and pelvis controlled.

name: Standing Rear-Leg Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance with the target leg behind.
Tuck the pelvis and gently shift the hips forward.
Use a wall for balance if needed.

name: Prone Hip Flexor and Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Lie face down and bend the target knee.
Use a strap to gently draw the heel toward the glute.
Keep the pelvis heavy and avoid lifting the hip.

name: Side-Lying Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with the target leg uppermost.
Bend the knee and gently extend the hip by moving the thigh backward.
Keep the pelvis stacked.

name: Elevated-Knee Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Place the target knee on a comfortable pad with the foot elevated if needed.
Tuck the pelvis and gently move the hips forward.
Keep the torso upright.

name: Split-Stance Hip Flexor Stretch With Reach
instructions: Step the target leg behind into a long stance.
Tuck the pelvis and shift forward.
Reach the arm overhead while maintaining abdominal control.

name: Bench-Supported Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel near a bench and place the rear foot or shin against a stable surface.
Maintain a tucked pelvis while gently extending the hip.
Keep the lower ribs controlled.

name: Elevated Glute Bridge Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the shoulders supported on a bench and one foot grounded.
Extend the target hip gently while maintaining a controlled pelvic position.
Avoid arching the lower back.

name: Wall-Supported Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel near a wall with the target leg behind.
Use the wall for posture and balance.
Tuck the pelvis and shift the hips forward gently.

name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Place the target foot behind you on a low bench.
Maintain a slight posterior pelvic tilt.
Gently move the hips forward without arching the spine.

name: Standing Side-Lunge Adductor Stretch
instructions: Stand with a wide stance.
Bend the non-target knee and shift your weight toward that side.
Keep the target leg straight with the foot grounded.

name: Half-Kneeling Adductor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the target leg extended out to the side.
Shift the hips toward the kneeling side.
Keep the extended leg straight and foot flat.

name: Frog Adductor Stretch
instructions: Begin on hands and knees and gradually widen the knees.
Keep the feet in line with the knees.
Shift the hips backward gently until the inner thighs stretch.

name: Seated Butterfly Adductor Stretch
instructions: Sit with the soles of the feet together.
Let the knees fall outward.
Sit tall and lean forward slightly from the hips.

name: Supine Straddle Adductor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and raise the legs.
Allow the legs to open outward under control.
Stop at a comfortable inner-thigh stretch.

name: Wall-Supported Adductor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the legs supported vertically against a wall.
Allow the legs to open apart gradually.
Keep the pelvis comfortable and relaxed.

name: Quadruped Side-Leg Adductor Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Extend the target leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Shift the hips backward gently.

name: Lateral Squat Adductor Stretch
instructions: Take a wide stance and sit into a lateral squat.
Keep the target leg straight.
Shift the pelvis until the inner thigh stretches.

name: Seated Single-Leg Adductor Stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and the other bent.
Move the extended target leg outward slightly.
Lean forward from the hips while keeping the spine long.

name: Half-Split Adductor Stretch
instructions: Start in a kneeling position and extend the target leg to the side.
Shift the hips backward slightly.
Keep the target knee straight and foot supported.

name: Wide-Stance Forward Fold Adductor Stretch
instructions: Stand with the feet comfortably wide.
Hinge forward from the hips.
Keep the knees softly extended and allow a gentle inner-thigh stretch.

name: Supported Cossack Adductor Stretch
instructions: Use a stable support and take a wide stance.
Shift into a supported Cossack position while straightening the target leg.
Keep the target foot grounded.

name: Kneeling Bench Latissimus Stretch
instructions: Kneel facing a bench and place both hands on it.
Sit the hips backward while reaching the arms forward.
Allow the upper back and lats to lengthen.

name: Child's Pose Latissimus Stretch
instructions: Kneel and sit the hips toward the heels.
Reach the arms forward and lower the chest.
Breathe slowly into the side body.

name: Child's Pose Side-Reach Lat Stretch
instructions: From child's pose, walk both hands toward one side.
Keep the hips back while lengthening the opposite side of the torso.
Hold a gentle lateral stretch.

name: Wall Latissimus Reach Stretch
instructions: Place both hands high against a wall.
Step backward and hinge the hips while reaching the chest downward.
Keep the arms long.

name: Single-Arm Wall Lat Stretch
instructions: Place the target hand high on the wall.
Shift the hips away from that side while reaching through the arm.
Keep the ribs controlled.

name: Half-Kneeling Latissimus Reach
instructions: Kneel with one foot forward.
Raise the target arm overhead and gently side-bend away.
Keep the pelvis stable.

name: Standing Overhead Lat Side Stretch
instructions: Raise the target arm overhead.
Reach upward and gently side-bend away from that side.
Keep both feet grounded.

name: Dowel-Assisted Latissimus Stretch
instructions: Hold a dowel with the target hand above the head.
Reach overhead and gently move the torso away from the target side.
Keep the shoulder comfortable.

name: Supine Overhead Latissimus Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and reach both arms overhead.
Extend through the fingertips without lifting the ribs excessively.
Allow the side body to lengthen.

name: Supine Single-Arm Latissimus Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with one arm reaching overhead.
Allow the target arm to lengthen away from the hips.
Keep the lower ribs from flaring.

name: Side-Lying Latissimus Stretch
instructions: Lie on the non-target side.
Reach the target arm overhead and slightly back.
Keep the pelvis stacked while lengthening the side body.

name: Prone Single-Arm Lat Reach
instructions: Lie face down and reach the target arm forward.
Gently lengthen through the fingertips while keeping the shoulder relaxed.
Avoid lifting the rib cage aggressively.

name: Seated Cervical Erector Flexion Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and gently lower the chin.
Allow the upper neck to lengthen while keeping the chest open.
Avoid forcing the head downward.

name: Cervical Erector Chin-Tuck Stretch
instructions: Sit upright and gently retract the head.
Add a small chin nod.
Hold without rounding the upper back.

name: Supine Cervical Erector Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the head supported.
Gently nod the chin and lengthen the back of the neck.
Keep the shoulders relaxed.

name: Towel-Assisted Cervical Erector Stretch
instructions: Place a towel around the back of the head.
Gently nod the chin while allowing the towel to support the skull.
Do not force cervical flexion.

name: Wall-Supported Cervical Retraction Stretch
instructions: Stand with the upper back and head lightly supported by the wall.
Gently draw the head backward.
Keep the chin level.

name: Seated Look-Down Cervical Stretch
instructions: Sit comfortably with the spine upright.
Lower the gaze and gently flex the neck.
Keep the movement slow and comfortable.

name: Cervical Erector Side-Assisted Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and tilt the head slightly forward and toward one side.
Allow the posterior neck to lengthen.
Use only a small range.

name: Supported Cervical Erector Chin Nod
instructions: Lie down with the head comfortably supported.
Perform a small chin nod to lengthen the posterior neck.
Keep the jaw relaxed.

name: Standing Wall Cervical Erector Stretch
instructions: Stand tall against a wall.
Gently retract the head and slightly nod the chin.
Do not press the head forcefully into the wall.

name: Diagonal Cervical Erector Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and gently lower the chin toward the upper chest.
Angle the head slightly toward one side.
Keep the shoulders relaxed.

name: Quadruped Cervical Erector Lengthening
instructions: Begin on hands and knees with the spine neutral.
Gently tuck the chin and lengthen the back of the neck.
Keep the shoulders away from the ears.

name: Chair-Supported Cervical Erector Stretch
instructions: Sit against a chair with the upper back supported.
Gently retract and nod the head.
Maintain an upright chest.

name: Low Doorway Pectoralis Major Stretch
instructions: Place the forearm on a doorway with the elbow slightly below shoulder height.
Step forward gently.
Keep the shoulder relaxed.

name: Mid-Height Doorway Pectoralis Major Stretch
instructions: Place the forearm against the doorway at approximately shoulder height.
Step forward slowly.
Keep the torso upright.

name: High Doorway Pectoralis Major Stretch
instructions: Place the arm high against a doorway frame.
Step forward gently while keeping the shoulder comfortable.
Maintain an open chest without arching the lower back.

name: Corner Pectoralis Major Stretch
instructions: Place both forearms against a wall corner.
Step forward gently until the chest stretches.
Keep the ribs controlled.

name: Single-Arm Wall Pectoralis Stretch
instructions: Place one palm and forearm against a wall.
Rotate the torso gently away from the arm.
Avoid excessive shoulder rotation.

name: Supine Open-Arm Pectoralis Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with one arm opened to the side.
Allow the chest to relax while maintaining comfortable shoulder positioning.
Keep the lower ribs down.

name: Foam Roller Snow-Angel Chest Stretch
instructions: Lie lengthwise on a foam roller with the head and spine supported.
Open the arms gradually toward the floor.
Stop before the shoulders feel strained.

name: Foam Roller T-Position Pectoral Stretch
instructions: Lie lengthwise on a foam roller.
Place both arms out to the sides in a T position.
Relax the chest and breathe slowly.

name: Supine Chest-Opening Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the arms comfortably abducted.
Allow the front of the chest to open without forcing the shoulders.
Maintain slow breathing.

name: Doorway Prayer-Position Chest Stretch
instructions: Place the forearms against the sides of a doorway.
Keep the elbows slightly below shoulder height.
Step forward until a moderate chest stretch is felt.

name: Dowel-Assisted Overhead Pectoral Stretch
instructions: Hold a dowel with both hands overhead.
Move the arms slightly backward while keeping the ribs controlled.
Stop before the shoulders become uncomfortable.

name: Unilateral Pectoralis Minor Wall Stretch
instructions: Place the target forearm high on a wall.
Rotate the torso gently away from the arm.
Keep the shoulder blade controlled.

name: High Doorway Pectoralis Minor Stretch
instructions: Place the target forearm high against a doorway.
Step through gently while keeping the shoulder relaxed.
Focus on lengthening the upper chest.

name: High Corner Pectoralis Minor Stretch
instructions: Place the forearms high against a wall corner.
Step forward gently.
Keep the lower ribs controlled.

name: Supine Pectoralis Minor Arm-Flexion Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target arm raised.
Allow the shoulder to settle while the arm moves gently overhead.
Avoid rib flare.

name: Supine Pectoralis Minor Horizontal Abduction Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target arm comfortably out to the side.
Let the shoulder settle toward the floor.
Maintain gentle breathing.

name: Foam Roller T-Position Pectoralis Minor Stretch
instructions: Lie lengthwise on a foam roller.
Open the arms into a comfortable T position.
Relax the front of the shoulders toward the floor.

name: Wall Angel Pectoralis Minor Stretch Hold
instructions: Stand with the back against a wall.
Position the arms in a comfortable goalpost shape and gently press the shoulders back.
Hold without forcing the arms into the wall.

name: Dowel-Assisted Chest Opening Stretch
instructions: Hold a dowel behind the body with a comfortable grip.
Gently move the arms backward without shrugging.
Keep the chest open and ribs controlled.

name: Scapular Retraction Pectoralis Minor Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall.
Gently draw the shoulder blades back and down.
Maintain a neutral rib cage while holding the chest open.

name: Single-Arm Doorframe Pectoralis Minor Stretch
instructions: Place the target arm high on a doorframe.
Turn the torso gently away from the arm.
Keep the shoulder blade controlled.

name: Bench-Supported Pectoralis Minor Stretch
instructions: Lie on a bench with the arms comfortably open.
Allow the shoulders to settle toward the bench.
Keep the lower back neutral.

name: Kneeling Bench Teres Major Stretch
instructions: Kneel facing a bench and place the target arm overhead.
Reach forward and sink the chest gently.
Keep the shoulder relaxed.

name: Wall-Reach Teres Major Stretch
instructions: Place the target hand high on the wall.
Reach upward and gently shift the body away.
Keep the upper arm near the ear without forcing it.

name: Child's Pose Teres Major Stretch
instructions: From child's pose, reach the target arm forward.
Shift the torso slightly away from that side.
Breathe into the back of the shoulder.

name: Side-Lying Teres Major Stretch
instructions: Lie on the non-target side.
Reach the target arm overhead and slightly back.
Keep the scapula relaxed.

name: Supine Overhead Teres Major Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and reach the target arm overhead.
Allow the arm to lengthen while keeping the ribs down.
Maintain a relaxed shoulder.

name: Dowel-Assisted Teres Major Stretch
instructions: Hold a dowel with the target hand and guide the arm overhead.
Reach upward while gently shifting the torso away.
Keep the shoulder comfortable.

name: Wall-Supported Teres Major Side-Bend Stretch
instructions: Place the target hand high on a wall.
Gently side-bend the torso away from the target arm.
Keep the arm long and shoulder relaxed.

name: Half-Kneeling Teres Major Stretch
instructions: Kneel with one foot forward.
Raise the target arm overhead and side-bend away.
Keep the pelvis stable.

name: Bench-Assisted Teres Major Side Reach
instructions: Place the target hand on a bench.
Step back and shift the torso away from the arm.
Allow the side of the upper back to lengthen.

name: Diagonal Child's Pose Teres Major Stretch
instructions: From child's pose, walk the target hand diagonally away.
Shift the hips backward.
Hold the stretch along the posterior axillary region.

name: Seated Overhead Teres Major Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and raise the target arm overhead.
Reach upward while gently side-bending away.
Keep the shoulder from shrugging.

name: Prone Teres Major Arm Reach Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with the target arm reaching overhead.
Lengthen through the fingertips while keeping the shoulder relaxed.
Avoid arching the lower back.

name: Gentle Subscapularis External-Rotation Stretch
instructions: Stand beside a doorframe with the target elbow bent to approximately 90 degrees.
Place the forearm against the frame and gently rotate the torso away.
Use only a mild shoulder stretch.

name: Dowel-Assisted Subscapularis Stretch
instructions: Hold a dowel with the target elbow bent and kept close to the side.
Use the opposite arm to gently guide the forearm outward.
Do not force the shoulder into end range.

name: Corner-Assisted Subscapularis Stretch
instructions: Place the target forearm against a wall corner with the elbow near the side.
Rotate the torso gently away from the arm.
Keep the shoulder blade stable.

name: Towel-Assisted Subscapularis Stretch
instructions: Hold one end of a towel behind the back with the target hand.
Use the opposite hand to gently guide the target arm upward or outward.
Stay within a comfortable shoulder range.

name: Wall-Assisted Shoulder External-Rotation Stretch
instructions: Stand with the target elbow bent at the side.
Place the forearm against the wall and gently rotate the body away.
Avoid painful shoulder rotation.

name: Supine External-Rotation Subscapularis Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Allow the forearm to gently move toward the floor.
Keep the upper arm supported and close to the body.

name: Supported 90-Degree External-Rotation Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the target arm abducted comfortably.
Allow the forearm to move gently toward the floor.
Use a smaller range if the shoulder feels unstable or pinchy.

name: Bench-Supported Subscapularis Stretch
instructions: Lie on a bench with the target elbow supported.
Allow the forearm to rotate outward gradually.
Keep the shoulder blade stable against the bench.

name: Behind-the-Back Dowel Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Hold a dowel behind the back with both hands.
Use the opposite hand to guide the target arm gently upward.
Keep the shoulder relaxed.

name: Seated Subscapularis External-Rotation Stretch
instructions: Sit upright with the target elbow bent and supported near the side.
Gently rotate the forearm outward.
Keep the shoulder blade down and back without forcing it.

name: Wall Goalpost External-Rotation Stretch
instructions: Stand with the back near a wall and place the target arm in a comfortable goalpost position.
Let the forearm move gently backward.
Do not force the shoulder against the wall.

name: Supported 90-90 Subscapularis Stretch
instructions: Position the target upper arm at approximately shoulder height with the elbow bent.
Support the arm and allow gentle external rotation.
Keep the shoulder comfortable and stable.

name: Supine Cranio-Cervical Flexion
instructions: Lie on your back with the head resting comfortably.
Gently nod the chin as if making a small double chin without lifting the head.
Return slowly to the starting position while keeping the neck relaxed.

name: Standing Wall Chin Tuck
instructions: Stand with the back of the head lightly touching a wall.
Draw the chin backward without looking up or down.
Slowly return to neutral.

name: Supine Towel-Supported Chin Nod
instructions: Place a thin towel beneath the head.
Perform a small chin nod while keeping the back of the head supported.
Release the contraction slowly.

name: Seated Chin Retraction
instructions: Sit tall with the eyes level.
Slide the head straight backward without tilting it.
Return slowly while maintaining an upright torso.

name: Band-Resisted Chin Retraction
instructions: Place a light resistance band around the back of the head.
Gently retract the head against the band's resistance.
Return under control without extending the neck.

name: Deep Neck Flexor Head Lift
instructions: Lie on your back and perform a gentle chin tuck.
Lift the head slightly while maintaining the chin position.
Lower the head slowly.

name: Wall-Supported Deep Neck Nod
instructions: Stand with the head lightly against a wall.
Gently nod the chin downward without moving the upper body.
Return slowly.

name: Seated Isolated Cervical Nod
instructions: Sit supported with the spine neutral.
Perform a small nod without bringing the chin toward the chest excessively.
Return to neutral slowly.

name: Towel-Assisted Deep Neck Flexor Lift
instructions: Place a towel beneath the head and lightly hold the ends.
Tuck the chin and lift the head a small amount.
Lower slowly while maintaining the neck position.

name: Supine Cervical Retraction
instructions: Lie flat with the neck relaxed.
Gently retract the head and create a small chin tuck.
Relax back to the starting position.

name: Seated Band-Resisted Cervical Retraction
instructions: Anchor a light band behind the head.
Pull the head backward into neutral alignment.
Return slowly against the resistance.

name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the arms overhead in a Y position.
Lift the arms slightly while drawing the shoulder blades down.
Lower slowly without shrugging.

name: Prone Dumbbell Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down holding very light dumbbells.
Raise the arms diagonally overhead into a Y.
Lower slowly while keeping the shoulders away from the ears.

name: Wall Y Raise
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the arms in a Y position.
Slide the arms upward while keeping the shoulders depressed.
Return slowly.

name: Resistance Band Y Raise
instructions: Anchor a light band below shoulder height.
Raise the arms diagonally upward into a Y while maintaining scapular control.
Return under control.

name: Cable Y Raise
instructions: Set the cable to a low position and hold the handle with the target arm.
Raise the arm diagonally overhead while keeping the scapula controlled.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down with one arm angled overhead.
Lift the arm slightly while drawing the shoulder blade down and inward.
Lower slowly.

name: Incline Bench Y Raise
instructions: Lie prone on a low incline bench.
Raise the arms overhead in a Y position.
Lower slowly while keeping the neck relaxed.

name: Wall Slide With Scapular Depression
instructions: Stand with the forearms against the wall.
Slide the arms upward while maintaining control of the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

name: Band Diagonal Scapular Raise
instructions: Anchor a light band below the target hand.
Raise the arm diagonally upward while keeping the shoulder away from the ear.
Lower slowly.

name: Cable Diagonal Raise
instructions: Use a low cable attachment with the target arm.
Raise the arm diagonally while controlling the scapula.
Return slowly.

name: Prone Diagonal Scapular Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the target arm diagonally overhead.
Lift the arm while gently depressing and upwardly rotating the scapula.
Lower under control.

name: Prone Cervical Extension
instructions: Lie face down with the head supported comfortably.
Lift the forehead slightly while lengthening the neck.
Lower slowly without compressing the back of the neck.

name: Prone Head Lift
instructions: Lie face down with the forehead near the mat.
Gently lift the head into a neutral position.
Return slowly.

name: Prone Band-Resisted Neck Extension
instructions: Place a very light band around the back of the head.
Extend the neck gently against the resistance.
Return slowly without forcing the range.

name: Seated Cervical Extension
instructions: Sit upright with the chin neutral.
Extend the neck slightly while keeping the torso still.
Return slowly to neutral.

name: Wall-Supported Cervical Extension
instructions: Stand with the upper back supported against a wall.
Move the head slightly backward into neutral.
Return slowly without shrugging.

name: Quadruped Neck Neutral Lift
instructions: Begin on hands and knees with the head aligned with the spine.
Gently lift the head toward a neutral position.
Lower slightly and repeat.

name: Seated Band Neck Extension
instructions: Anchor a light band in front of the forehead.
Gently extend the head backward against the resistance.
Return slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Cervical Extension
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with the chest supported.
Lift the head into neutral alignment.
Lower slowly.

name: Prone Cervical Retraction Lift
instructions: Lie face down with the forehead near the floor.
Retract the head slightly before lifting it toward neutral.
Lower with control.

name: Seated Gentle Neck Extension Resistance
instructions: Place the hand lightly behind the head.
Press the head backward against the hand while allowing a small controlled movement.
Return slowly.

name: Wall Head-Lift Activation
instructions: Stand with the upper back against a wall and the head slightly away from it.
Bring the head gently backward toward neutral.
Return under control.

name: Band-Resisted Cervical Retraction Lift
instructions: Place a light band around the back of the head.
Move the head gently backward into neutral against the resistance.
Return slowly.

name: Supported Neck Extension Lift
instructions: Lie face down with the forehead just beyond the edge of a bench.
Lift the head only to neutral.
Lower slowly without excessive extension.

name: Band Scapular Row
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height.
Pull the elbows backward while drawing the shoulder blades toward the spine.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Scapular Row
instructions: Set a cable at mid-chest height.
Pull the handle toward the torso while squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

name: Prone T Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the arms extended to the sides.
Lift the arms while gently retracting the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: Prone Dumbbell T Raise
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells.
Raise the arms sideways while drawing the shoulder blades together.
Lower under control.

name: Seated Band Row With Scapular Retraction
instructions: Sit with the band anchored in front.
Pull the elbows backward and squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

name: Single-Arm Cable Scapular Retraction
instructions: Hold a single cable handle with the target arm.
Pull the elbow back while retracting the shoulder blade.
Return slowly.

name: Wall Scapular Retraction
instructions: Stand with the forearms against a wall.
Gently draw the shoulder blades together without shrugging.
Return to the starting position slowly.

name: Prone Elbow Row
instructions: Lie face down with the arms extended.
Pull the elbows toward the ribs while retracting the shoulder blades.
Extend the arms back slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Incline Row
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells.
Pull the elbows back while squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: Band Reverse Fly
instructions: Hold a light band in front of the chest.
Separate the hands by drawing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
instructions: Set the cables around chest height.
Pull the handles outward while retracting the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Drive through the heels and lift the hips by squeezing the glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Banded Glute Bridge
instructions: Place a mini-band above the knees.
Bridge upward while keeping the knees aligned.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg extended.
Drive through the planted heel to lift the pelvis.
Lower slowly without rotating the hips.

name: Prone Hip Extension
instructions: Lie face down with the legs straight.
Lift one leg slightly by squeezing the glute.
Lower slowly without arching the lower back.

name: Band Glute Kickback
instructions: Anchor a band behind you or around the ankle.
Extend the hip backward without rotating the pelvis.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Hip Extension
instructions: Attach the cable to the ankle.
Extend the hip backward while keeping the torso stable.
Return slowly.

name: Quadruped Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Drive one heel upward while keeping the pelvis level.
Lower the leg slowly.

name: Banded Donkey Kick
instructions: Place a mini-band around the feet or ankles.
Drive the heel upward against the band.
Lower slowly while keeping the trunk stable.

name: Bench-Supported Hip Extension
instructions: Support the torso on a bench with the target leg hanging down.
Extend the hip by squeezing the glute.
Lower the leg slowly.

name: Bent-Knee Floor Hip Extension
instructions: Lie face down with the target knee bent.
Lift the thigh slightly by contracting the glute.
Lower under control.

name: Standing Band Hip Extension
instructions: Anchor a band in front of the target leg.
Move the leg backward against resistance.
Return slowly without leaning forward.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with the target leg on top.
Lift the leg upward without rolling the pelvis backward.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Band Hip Abduction
instructions: Place a band around the ankles.
Move the target leg outward while keeping the pelvis level.
Return slowly.

name: Banded Lateral Leg Lift
instructions: Place a mini-band above the knees.
Shift the target leg outward against resistance.
Return under control.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with the knees bent.
Keep the feet together and lift the top knee without rolling the pelvis.
Lower slowly.

name: Banded Clamshell
instructions: Place the band above the knees.
Open the top knee while keeping the feet together.
Return slowly.

name: Wall-Supported Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand beside a wall for balance.
Move the outside leg laterally without tilting the torso.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
instructions: Attach the cable to the target ankle.
Move the leg laterally against resistance.
Return slowly while keeping the pelvis level.

name: Quadruped Hip Abduction
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift the target knee outward while keeping the trunk stable.
Lower slowly.

name: Banded Quadruped Hip Abduction
instructions: Place a mini-band around the thighs.
Lift the target knee outward against the band.
Lower with control.

name: Side Plank Hip Abduction
instructions: Set up in a side plank from the knees or feet.
Lift the top leg while maintaining a straight body line.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Hip Abduction With Pelvic Control
instructions: Hold a stable support and stand on one leg.
Move the free leg slightly outward.
Return slowly while keeping the pelvis level.

name: Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit upright with a mini-band above the knees.
Press the knees gently outward against the band.
Return slowly.

name: Supine Abdominal Bracing
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent.
Gently draw the lower abdomen inward while breathing normally.
Release the contraction slowly.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs raised.
Brace the abdomen while lowering the opposite arm and leg.
Return slowly while keeping the lower back controlled.

name: Dead Bug Heel Taps
instructions: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent.
Brace the abdomen and lower one heel toward the floor.
Return slowly without arching the back.

name: Supine Alternating Leg Extension
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent.
Brace the abdomen and extend one leg outward.
Return slowly while keeping the pelvis still.

name: Supine Core March
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Brace the abdomen and lift one foot a few centimeters.
Lower slowly and alternate sides.

name: Bent-Knee Fallout
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Brace the abdomen and allow one knee to open slightly.
Return slowly without rotating the pelvis.

name: Supine Heel Slide
instructions: Lie on your back and brace the abdomen.
Slide one heel away from the body.
Return slowly while maintaining pelvic control.

name: Banded Dead Bug
instructions: Set a light band around the hands or feet.
Maintain abdominal bracing while moving the opposite limbs.
Return slowly without losing trunk position.

name: Kneeling Pallof Press
instructions: Kneel beside a band anchored to one side.
Press the band away from the chest while resisting rotation.
Return slowly.

name: Quadruped Abdominal Brace
instructions: Begin on hands and knees with the spine neutral.
Brace the abdominal wall without holding the breath.
Relax slowly while keeping the spine stable.

name: Standing Band Anti-Rotation Press
instructions: Stand perpendicular to a band anchor.
Press the hands forward while keeping the torso square.
Return slowly without rotating.

name: Band Ankle Dorsiflexion
instructions: Anchor the band in front of the foot.
Pull the toes and forefoot upward against resistance.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Toe Raises
instructions: Sit with the feet flat.
Lift the forefoot while keeping the heels down.
Lower slowly.

name: Weighted Seated Toe Raise
instructions: Sit with a light weight resting gently over the forefoot.
Lift the toes and forefoot upward.
Lower slowly.

name: Wall-Supported Toe Raise
instructions: Lean lightly against a wall with the feet slightly forward.
Lift the forefeet while keeping the heels planted.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Band Dorsiflexion
instructions: Sit with the target foot secured to the resistance band.
Pull the foot upward through dorsiflexion.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Dorsiflexion
instructions: Attach a light cable cuff to the forefoot.
Pull the toes upward against the cable.
Return slowly.

name: Heel Walks
instructions: Walk forward while keeping the toes lifted and weight through the heels.
Maintain controlled dorsiflexion throughout each step.
Move slowly and maintain balance.

name: Standing Heel-Anchored Toe Raise
instructions: Hold a stable support while standing.
Lift the forefeet and toes from the floor.
Lower slowly.

name: Slant-Board Toe Lift
instructions: Stand on a slight incline with the heels supported.
Lift the forefeet upward.
Lower slowly while maintaining balance.

name: Band Dorsiflexion From Elevated Heel
instructions: Sit with the heel supported slightly above the floor.
Pull the forefoot upward against the band.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Toe Lift
instructions: Stand on one leg while holding support.
Lift the toes and forefoot of the standing foot.
Lower slowly.

name: Band-Resisted Ankle Inversion
instructions: Anchor the band to the outside of the foot.
Turn the sole inward against resistance.
Return slowly.

name: Seated Ankle Inversion
instructions: Sit with the foot unloaded.
Turn the sole inward while keeping the leg still.
Return slowly.

name: Band Inversion With Plantarflexion
instructions: Anchor the band outside the foot.
Point the foot slightly downward while turning the sole inward.
Return slowly.

name: Single-Leg Heel Raise With Inward Foot Control
instructions: Stand on one leg while holding support.
Rise onto the ball of the foot while maintaining a controlled arch.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Ball-Guided Inversion
instructions: Place a small ball beside the inner edge of the target foot.
Press gently into the ball by turning the sole inward.
Return slowly.

name: Single-Leg Band Inversion
instructions: Secure the band to the outer side of the target foot.
Invert the foot against resistance.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Ankle Inversion
instructions: Attach a light cuff around the forefoot.
Turn the sole inward against the cable.
Return slowly.

name: Heel Raise With Ball Between Heels
instructions: Place a small ball between the heels.
Rise onto the balls of the feet while maintaining gentle heel alignment.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Plantarflexion-Inversion
instructions: Sit with a resistance band around the forefoot.
Point the foot slightly downward while turning it inward.
Return slowly.

name: Step Heel Raise With Arch Control
instructions: Stand on a step with the forefoot supported.
Rise onto the toes while controlling the arch.
Lower slowly below the starting position.

name: Band Arch-Control Inversion
instructions: Anchor a band outside the foot.
Invert the foot while gently maintaining the medial arch.
Return slowly.

name: Supported Heel Raise With Arch Control
instructions: Hold a stable support and stand with the feet parallel.
Rise onto the toes while maintaining the foot arch.
Lower slowly.

name: Dead Bug With Controlled Rotation Resistance
instructions: Lie on your back with the limbs raised.
Brace the trunk while lowering opposite limbs.
Keep the pelvis and rib cage controlled.

name: Side-Lying Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie on your side with the legs bent.
Gently bring the rib cage toward the pelvis on the target side.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Band Anti-Rotation Press
instructions: Stand perpendicular to the band anchor.
Press the hands forward while resisting the pull to rotate.
Return slowly.

name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
instructions: Kneel beside an anchored band.
Press the hands forward while keeping the torso facing ahead.
Return slowly.

name: Side Plank From Knees
instructions: Set up on the forearm and knees.
Lift the hips while maintaining a straight line through the trunk.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Band-Resisted Rotation
instructions: Sit upright with the band anchored beside you.
Rotate the torso toward the opposite side under control.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Standing Rotation
instructions: Set the cable around chest height.
Rotate the torso smoothly through the target direction while keeping the pelvis stable.
Return slowly.

name: Band-Resisted Dead Bug
instructions: Set a light band across the hands or feet.
Brace the trunk while moving opposite limbs.
Keep the pelvis level throughout.

name: Bear Position Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start in a bear position with the knees slightly lifted.
Tap one shoulder while resisting trunk rotation.
Return the hand slowly and alternate.

name: Quadruped Knee Hover
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Brace the abdomen and hover the knees slightly from the floor.
Lower slowly while keeping the trunk stable.

name: Seated Cross-Body Knee Drive
instructions: Sit tall with the hands behind the head or across the chest.
Bring one knee toward the opposite side of the trunk with controlled rotation.
Return slowly.

name: Side Plank With Reach
instructions: Set up in a side plank.
Reach the top arm forward while maintaining trunk alignment.
Return slowly.

name: Prone T Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the arms extended sideways.
Lift the arms while drawing the shoulder blades toward the spine.
Lower slowly.

name: Prone Dumbbell T Raise
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells.
Raise the arms into a T while retracting the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: Band Middle-Trapezius Row
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height.
Pull the elbows backward while squeezing the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Middle-Trapezius Row
instructions: Set the cable around chest height.
Row the handle toward the rib cage while retracting the shoulder blade.
Return slowly.

name: Single-Arm Scapular Row
instructions: Anchor a band in front of the target side.
Pull the elbow back while bringing the shoulder blade toward the spine.
Return slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells.
Pull the elbows backward while retracting the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: Bent-Over Reverse Fly
instructions: Hinge forward while holding light dumbbells.
Open the arms outward while drawing the shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Band Reverse Fly
instructions: Hold the band in front of the body.
Separate the hands while retracting the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

name: Wall Scapular Retraction Drill
instructions: Stand against a wall with the arms relaxed.
Gently bring the shoulder blades together.
Release slowly without shrugging.

name: Prone Elbow Row
instructions: Lie face down with the elbows bent.
Lift the elbows slightly while retracting the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
instructions: Set the cables at chest height.
Open the arms outward while retracting the scapulae.
Return slowly.

name: Serratus Wall Slide
instructions: Place the forearms against the wall.
Slide the arms upward while allowing the shoulder blades to upwardly rotate.
Lower slowly without shrugging.

name: Wall Push-Up Plus
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the hands at shoulder height.
Perform a wall push-up and then actively push the wall away at the top.
Return slowly.

name: Supine Serratus Punch
instructions: Lie on your back holding a light dumbbell with the arm straight upward.
Reach the fist toward the ceiling by lifting the shoulder blade slightly from the floor.
Lower slowly.

name: Band Serratus Punch
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and hold it with one hand.
Press the arm forward while reaching through the shoulder blade.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Serratus Punch
instructions: Hold a cable handle at shoulder height.
Press forward while allowing controlled scapular protraction.
Return slowly.

name: Forearm Wall Press Plus
instructions: Place the forearms against a wall.
Press the forearms into the wall and gently push the shoulder blades around the rib cage.
Return slowly.

name: Quadruped Scapular Push-Up
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the elbows straight.
Push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades.
Return slowly without bending the elbows.

name: Knee Push-Up Plus
instructions: Begin from a knee push-up position.
At the top, push the floor away and protract the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

name: Wall Slide With Dumbbell Reach
instructions: Hold light dumbbells while facing a wall.
Slide the arms upward while reaching through the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: Serratus Scaption Raise
instructions: Hold light dumbbells with the thumbs facing upward.
Raise the arms in the scapular plane while allowing smooth upward rotation.
Lower slowly.

name: Band-Resisted Wall Slide
instructions: Place a light band around the wrists.
Press outward against the band while sliding the arms upward.
Lower slowly.

name: Cable Serratus Diagonal Reach
instructions: Hold a light cable handle near the shoulder.
Reach diagonally upward while allowing controlled scapular movement.
Return slowly.

name: Band Diagonal Serratus Reach
instructions: Anchor a band behind you.
Reach the arm diagonally forward and upward while protracting the shoulder blade.
Return slowly.

name: Side-Lying External Rotation
instructions: Lie on the non-target side with the target elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate the forearm upward while keeping the elbow against the side.
Lower slowly.
